findings.summary: Mixed-group preservation freezes a stale `uv run --with <path>` and deletes the fresh template copy; re-render no longer self-heals
findings.suggestion: Rewrite the preserved user hook's `--with` ref to the current install ref (reuse the `<HM>:` match span) before suppressing, or suppress only when the preserved command's raw text equals the template's.

findings.summary: user_scoped is event-global, so scoping one matcher deletes the command from an untouched sibling template entry (PreCompact auto/manual)
findings.suggestion: Key suppression by (normalized_command, matcher) per PLAN Phase 2's stated multi-matcher rule: build dict[command, set[matcher]] from the template and only drop from the entry whose matcher the user actually re-scoped.

findings.summary: Flat (Cursor) suppression IS the matcher-difference rule ADR-003 rejected as unsound — one command per entry means mixed-group evidence is structurally unavailable
findings.suggestion: Gate the flat branch on positive provenance, or restrict it to entries whose raw command byte-matches a shipped one; otherwise emit both and accept the duplicate until provenance lands.

findings.summary: The template's own blocking gate is dropped with zero diagnostic output; ADR-003 explicitly relies on a render warning that was never implemented
findings.suggestion: Emit typer.echo(..., err=True) beside the drop naming the suppressed commands, the event and the user matcher now carrying them — matching render.py:1173.

findings.summary: Phase 1 validates the TEMPLATE's install ref, then ADR-004 suppresses that validated entry in favour of a user entry whose `--with` ref the render never inspects
findings.suggestion: Before adding a command to user_scoped, compare its literal `--with` ref to the template's; if they differ, keep shipping the template entry or warn naming both refs.

findings.summary: `_pinned_distribution_ref` pins any non-empty version, including local/pre-release versions absent from the index, leaving every rendered blocking hook unresolvable
findings.suggestion: Reject a local/dev version (PEP 440 local segment or a pre-release with no index presence) and drop to the bare name, or verify resolvability before pinning.

findings.summary: A working wheel/sdist `file://` install ref is rewritten to a version pin that may not exist on the index
findings.suggestion: Accept the ref when it is a file uv can install (.whl/.tar.gz); or prefer `_portablize_ref(_HARNESS_MAKER_PKG_ROOT)` when that root is itself a resolvable project before falling back to a PyPI pin.

findings.summary: Warnings use `print(file=sys.stderr)`; ADR-001 specifies typer.echo(err=True) and CLAUDE.md forbids print for control flow
findings.suggestion: Replace both print calls with typer.echo(..., err=True) and drop the new `sys` import.

findings.summary: No test ships one command under two template matchers, nor re-merges the output, hiding the event-global suppression defect
findings.suggestion: Add a PreCompact-shaped case (same command under 'auto' and 'manual', user mixes into 'auto') asserting 'manual' still ships both commands, plus an idempotency assertion.

findings.summary: Command-global suppression removes valid registrations under unrelated template matchers
findings.suggestion: Add a matcher dimension to the suppression set.
